verdict.rationale: Kling's first-party llms.txt documents a RESTful API with JWT-based AccessKey/SecretKey authentication, published global and China API endpoints, and per-unit generation pricing. The site also advertises MCP/CLI access so agents can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint/reference documentation (request schemas, task polling, rate limits) in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: RESTful API with JWT-based authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey)
MCP / CLI Let Your Agent Power Kling, Turn Ideas into Videos at Scale
